changeSet.comment: The write fence of a conversation copy binds the Heph turn that claimed it and the Heph answer that showed it, as it bound the chat message.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION conversation_receipt_words(p_workspace_id bigint,p_feedback_id uuid,p_entry_id uuid,p_turn_id uuid) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $words$ -- The one rule for the words of a conversation receipt: the text of each show_feedback call of the answer that -- names the feedback by a well-formed id in any letter case and whose tool result is no error, in call order. -- Only the completed answer of the claiming turn, to the developer of the feedback, counts. SELECT NULLIF(( SELECT string_agg(block.value->'arguments'->>'text',E'\n\n' ORDER BY block.position) FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'message'->'content')='array' THEN e.payload->'message'->'content' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) WITH ORDINALITY AS block(value,position) WHERE block.value->>'type'='toolCall' AND block.value->>'name'='show_feedback' AND jsonb_typeof(block.value->'arguments'->'text')='string' AND block.value->'arguments'->>'feedbackId' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND lower(block.value->'arguments'->>'feedbackId')=CAST(p_feedback_id AS text) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mentor_entry r WHERE r.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND r.turn_id=e.turn_id AND r.kind='TOOL_RESULT' AND r.redacted_at IS NULL AND r.payload->'message'->>'toolCallId'=block.value->>'id' AND r.payload->'message'->>'toolName'='show_feedback' AND COALESCE(r.payload->'message'->>'isError','false')<>'true')),'') FROM mentor_entry e JOIN mentor_conversation c ON(c.id,c.workspace_id)=(e.conversation_id,e.workspace_id) JOIN mentor_turn t ON(t.id,t.workspace_id)=(e.turn_id,e.workspace_id) JOIN feedback f ON(f.id,f.workspace_id)=(p_feedback_id,p_workspace_id) AND f.developer_id=c.account_id WHERE e.id=p_entry_id AND e.workspace_id=p_workspace_id AND e.turn_id=p_turn_id AND e.kind='HEPH' AND e.redacted_at IS NULL AND t.status='DONE' $words$
CREATE TRIGGER feedback_copy_fence_monotonic BEFORE UPDATE ON feedback_copy FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_feedback_copy_fence()
